verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in, in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The closest items are an API endpoint for running a published "agent processor" on a document and an endpoint that generates candidate extraction schemas. Both are document-processing primitives invoked through the API, not an assistant inside the product, so they are adjacent and earn no credit. The Forge playground is only a UI for previewing processing results.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
